main_measure.name: |forecast|-weighted mean signed 5-bar excess return (short side)

statistic.name: t of the weighted mean, cases of one day pooled

main_measure.threshold: confirm above 0 with t >= 2 and the supporting check above 0; reject below 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: larger-|forecast| half minus smaller-|forecast| half signed excess return

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2 (or cannot be computed), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: The falling calm profile is read from the recorded regime (not 'chop'); halves are split by rank of |forecast| (middle case left out when odd) and compared by their unweighted mean; the day-pooled t sums the weighted deviations per UTC day (cluster-robust, J/(J-1) correction); the plan's 'fewer than 30 grid cases' minimum is reported as not observable.
